items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Sir Charles, Oscar Pettiford, Denzil Best, me and Hawk.

ctx.x: Sir Charles, Oscar Pettiford, Denzil Best, me and Hawk. And Hawk and I, at that time, we had gotten pretty tight together, because I learned a lot of the things that he was doing and he learned some of the things that I was doing. So we had a very mutual agreement as far as playing was concerned, except for... The only thing our difference was, was money.
Well, we'll get to that record date. I remember you telling me about that.
